meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Why am I here, Hale? Nobody called me about Owen's zero.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
The company that sells that checker says it shouldn't be the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too?

Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

Put it on his record and I'll be in the principal's office tonight, then the board. Under which section, and who decided that before anyone spoke to him? Your own procedure says nothing goes on file for a first concern.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that nothing be placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, agreed to nothing, and still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on Owen's record; that is not the fair outcome, which was a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time did not run out.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a document, a time or a sample of his work in front of her that she could check.
What cost ground: Threatening to put it on his permanent record cost you the most, because that is the one thing she never trades, and it cut against your own procedure for a first concern.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, since you offered only the detector score, and that proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she asked what else you had, own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then show one dated item tied to Owen's own work that she could check herself.
